''See also: [[Yan Shoumei Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Yan Shoumei, also known as Shoumei, is a [[Redmoon]] [[Truegold]] from [[Redmoon Hall]] and the chosen of [[Reigan Shen]]. She possesses a distinct [[Blood Shadow]] that she utilizes as both a garment and an extension of her [[sacred arts]], providing her with a significant combat advantage. Her fighting style involves specialized [[blood]] techniques designed to work in synergy with her [[Shadow]], such as the [[Crusher]] [[technique]], which creates a protective diamond of Red madra{{!}}red madra. Shoumei has a ghostly, specter-like appearance characterized by long black hair that often veil{{!}}veils her face and pale features. Her history is marked by hardship; she was abandoned as an infant and raised by various families after being found by fishermen. She has faced significant trauma involving a petty tyrant named [[Anagi]], who oppressed her town and family through heavy taxation and the use of [[slaughter artists]]. In combat, she has demonstrated intense emotions, including rage and hatred, and has sustained severe injuries in battle. She has served as a team leader and participated in high-stakes matches, including one against Eithan{{!}}Eithan Arelius.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Uncrowned tournament fighter}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Yan Shoumei is a competitor in the Uncrowned King Tournament{{!}}Uncrowned tournament and a [[disciple]] of the [[Blood Sage]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c7">''Wintersteel'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c11">''Wintersteel'', chapter 11</ref> A member of [[Redmoon Hall]], this black-haired fighter has one visible eye and wears [[sacred arts]] robes.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c7" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c11" /> As a [[Dreadgod cultist]] and the chosen of [[Reigan Shen]], Yan Shoumei interacts with [[Yerin]] and Calan Archer{{!}}Calan while fighting within [[Calan Archer]]'s faction.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c11" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c17">''Wintersteel'', chapter 17</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c21">''Wintersteel'', chapter 21</ref> This [[Redmoon artist]] utilizes [[blood madra]] and [[Striker techniques]], employing a collection of [[blood]] arts designed to synergize with a [[Shadow]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c15">''Wintersteel'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c21" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c22">''Wintersteel'', chapter 22</ref> Yan Shoumei possesses the [[Divine Treasure]] known as the [[Ancient Scale]], an [[Archlord weapon]] in her [[soulspace]], and a forged [[Red Crystal]] for protection.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c21" /> During combat, such as her match against Sopharanatoth{{!}}Sophara, she gathers [[blood madra]] in her palms and utilizes a [[Blood Shadow]] that provides more-than-physical strength.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c27">''Wintersteel'', chapter 27</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c28">''Wintersteel'', chapter 28</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Overlady of Sailfin Port}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A [[Truegold]] whose [[Blood Shadow]] is currently developing, Yan Shoumei was abandoned on a dock as an infant before being raised by six fishermen.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c3">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 3</ref> She utilizes the [[Red Crystal]] [[technique]] and possesses both an [[Iron body]] and an [[Ancient Scale]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c3" /> Following training by the [[Akura clan]], she became a [[Redmoon artist]] of [[Redmoon Hall]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c3" /> As an [[Uncrowned]] who can unleash her [[Blood Shadow]], she serves as the [[Overlady]] of [[Sailfin Port]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c3" /> She wields a bow to summon the [[Midnight Rain]] [[technique]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c3" />}}
